sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Stuart D. Fore.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Fore worked for the American Fork Police Department from November 29, 2004 to March 31, 2025.

Fore retired from the American Fork Police Department in 2025 after approximately 20 years with the department. American Fork City publicly recognized his service and announced his upcoming retirement shortly before his recorded employment end date.

segments.text: transcript of Chief Cameron Paul’s September 16, 2026 interview with Daniel Sroka
records the following comments. Quotations below are from the final edited transcript.

contents.text_value: Discussing Fore’s retirement and subsequent work, Chief Paul said:

segments.text: “Such a good guy. He retired. He's working at a county sheriff's office in Mississippi right now. Such a good guy. He retired, though.”
